title: Includes and interpolation for a Python config loader
prompt: config.py loads simple config files (sections and key = value lines). Extend load(path, env=None) as SPEC.md describes: %include lines with paths relative to the including file, later definitions overriding earlier ones, ${key} and ${env:NAME} interpolation resolved after every file is read, $$ as a literal dollar sign, and ConfigError with the exact messages the spec gives for a missing include, an include cycle, an undefined key or variable, and an interpolation cycle. Python 3 standard library only. Do not change SPEC.md, test_config.py or anything in fixtures/.
